name: OpenStatus Template
summary: shadcn/ui starter template with an uptime-monitoring dashboard, a status page and a marketing site, on Next.js in SPA mode.
description: An open-source shadcn/ui app template that runs on Next.js in SPA mode and can be exported statically with your own router. It ships three demo surfaces — a monitoring dashboard (monitors, status pages, notifiers, settings), a public status page, and the OpenStatus marketing site — plus documented higher-level components: ActionCard, SectionCard, FormCard, MetricCard and EmptyState.
contains: shadcn/ui template on Next.js in SPA mode, exportable statically (BYO router)
three surfaces: monitoring dashboard, status page, marketing landing
documented components: ActionCard, SectionCard, FormCard, MetricCard, EmptyState
demo dashboard with monitors, status pages, notifiers and settings
marketing demo includes a pricing comparison table, changelog, blog and competitor compare pages
